verdict.rationale: The DGFiP professional pages offer a professional account login, a 'Payer en ligne' (pay online) service, and FAQ entries on accessing and paying CFE/IFER notices online, including direct debit. Paying business taxes, a core transaction of this service, can therefore be completed online per its own pages. missing for 10: explicit first-party evidence of online filing of professional tax returns (e.g., VAT or corporate tax declarations), detailed docs beyond navigation-link titles, independent or hands-on corroboration.
